title: Florida House, District 62
what_it_does: Represents District 62 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat. Kyandra Darling won the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary over Wengay Newton. The Tampa Bay Times labeled it a Democratic primary (not universal), which implies a November opponent; that opponent's name was not found.
verified_ballot_note: Tampa Bay Times (Aug. 18, 2026): 'HD 62 (South St. Petersburg) Democratic Primary: This open seat was won by Kyandra Darling against Wengay Newton' (https://www.tampabay.com/news/florida-politics/elections/2026/08/18/florida-legislature-house-senate-legislative-results-primary-2026/). Florida Politics (June 2026) describes the district as covering part of Pinellas (St. Petersburg) and part of Hillsborough (Tampa, Gibsonton). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
